name: allow-live-smoke-transcript-lifecycle-artifact
title: Allow live-smoke transcript evidence as a TEST lifecycle artifact in scope gates
description: B-ce03 exposed a scope gate bug: live_smoke_transcript writes .lattice/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json during TEST, but scope classification treats that command-generated story evidence as out-of-scope. The DONE gate then suggests scope_contract_acknowledge even though that command is forbidden in TEST. Fix the lifecycle artifact classifier so the supported live-smoke transcript artifact passes scope without weakening arbitrary nested evidence files.
